## Personality

Phillips is characterized by a personality that others find horrid and sarcastic. Despite these traits, his behavior can still elicit a deeply emotional response from those around him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Mr. Phillips was a teacher known for frequently whipping his students while failing to maintain any order in his classroom. During his time at the school, he disciplined [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class after she broke a slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head, and later forced her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) as a further punishment. He eventually departed from his role as the local schoolmaster, leaving [Anne](../character/anne.md) emotional about his leaving as the community prepared to welcome a new minister and subsequent changes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phillips.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as Anne's schoolteacher, though their dynamic is strained and prone to conflict. After he punishes her by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) becomes so upset that she temporarily decides to leave school altogether. Although [Anne](../character/anne.md) later expresses emotional feelings regarding his eventual departure from the school, their relationship remains defined by strict teacher-student discipline.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

### [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Mr. Phillips is romantically involved with [Prissy Andrews](../character/prissy-andrews.md), actively courting her during his time in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their courtship takes place in the background of school and community life up until his departure from the school.

- Romantically involved with — courting  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>

### [Sam](../character/sam.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--sam.md)

Mr. Phillips acts as a mentor to [Sam](../character/sam.md). He provides guidance and instruction as part of his educational responsibilities.

- Mentor of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>
